cdiscpilot01.title: CDISC Pilot 01
cdiscpilot01.description: The original CDISC SDTM/ADaM pilot study, with eight active derivations and official reference datasets.

submission-pilot3.title: Submission Pilot 3
submission-pilot3.description: Five ADaM datasets from the R Consortium's Pilot 3 FDA submission, derived from the staged SDTM data.

submission-pilot5.title: Submission Pilot 5
submission-pilot5.description: The Dataset-JSON pilot: SDTM converted from Dataset-JSON 1.1 and five official ADaM reference datasets.

submission-pilot6.title: Submission Pilot 6
submission-pilot6.description: The ADaM and TLF expansion on CDISC Pilot 01. All 21 SDTM inputs and 8 production ADaM references are staged from upstream DVC data; the initial ADSL proposal and official comparisons remain pending.
